title: Whole-operation DIMENSION, ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION allocation rollback and retry
scope: Add all seven standard typed DIMENSION subtypes, the separate ARC_DIMENSION writer path and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION to the existing whole-operation ASCII/Binary allocation failure sweep.

commonFields.construction: Typed DRW_* dimension records serialized in the existing generated whole-operation drawing

allocationSweep.ascii: 647/647 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.
allocationSweep.binary: 640/640 offsets injected; previous destination, caller fields, and derived identity maps preserved; same-writer retry reproduced clean output and typed readback passed.

validation.readback: Exactly one callback was delivered for each of the seven standard subtypes, ARC_DIMENSION and LARGE_RADIAL_DIMENSION. Common text/style fields and subtype-specific WCS/OCS geometry match typed profiles; large radial chord, overridden center, jog point and group-40 jog angle match; generated handles are nonzero and remapped.

limitations: This verifies allocation rollback/retry and typed DXF roundtrip only; it does not qualify native dimension rendering or producer-specific DWG semantics.
Custom/dynamic dimension profiles and broader dimension writer profiles remain outside this control.
No full test suite was run.
fixturePolicy: No DWG/DXF fixture was committed; the drawing is generated by the test in scratch storage.
